sloka: स पश्चिमेन द्वारेण निर्ययौ राक्षसैर्वृतः।इन्द्रजित्तु महावीर्यः पौलस्त्यो देवकण्टकः ।। ६.८१.३ ।।
transliteration: sa paścimena dvāreṇa niryayau rākṣasairvṛtaḥ।indrajittu mahāvīryaḥ paulastyo devakaṇṭakaḥ ।। 6.81.3 ।।

translations.english: Paulastya (one of the nine mind born sons of Brahma, a scion of sage Paulastya), stupendous hero, a tormentor of Devatas, Indrajith, surrounded by Rakshasas came out through the western gate.
